name: Premium Industrial Minimalism
notes: Single source of truth for the design system. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/build-tokens.mjs` to regenerate design/generated/*. Values marked (suggested) came from the original brief and may be tuned; contrast ratios in `usage` are measured against the surface named there.

canvas.usage: Page background (suggested). Warm neutral; every contrast ratio below is measured on this unless stated.

canvas-2.usage: Alternate section band, table header rows, quiet fills. Never for text.

surface.usage: Cards, inputs, dialogs, product image stages. Sits on canvas with a hairline, not a shadow.

surface-ink.usage: Dark band / footer / primary button fill. Text on it: canvas-on-ink.

surface-ink-hover.usage: Hover state of ink-filled buttons and the dark band's borders.

ink.usage: Primary text and headings (suggested). 16.5:1 on canvas.

ink-2.usage: Secondary body text, spec table values. 8.7:1 on canvas.

ink-muted.usage: Captions, helper text, placeholders. 5.4:1 on canvas, 5.8:1 on surface — the lightest text colour allowed.

canvas-on-ink-muted.usage: Secondary text on surface-ink (footer small print). 8.1:1 on surface-ink.

accent.usage: Brand accent (suggested): terracotta. Large type ≥24px, icons, rules, selected states, sale/stock highlights. 3.8:1 on canvas — NOT for body-size text; use accent-ink.

accent-ink.usage: Accent for small text, links and accent-filled buttons with white labels. 5.3:1 on canvas; white on it 5.7:1.

accent-soft.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: badges, callouts, selected option background. Text on it must be accent-ink or ink.

secondary.usage: Kraft / paper brown (suggested). Decorative only: swatches, image stages, dividers, illustration. 2.6:1 on canvas — never text.

secondary-ink.usage: Kraft tone usable for text and small UI. 5.6:1 on canvas.

secondary-soft.usage: Kraft tint for material-option fills and product stage backgrounds.

hairline.usage: Default 1px divider and card border on canvas/surface. Decorative (not a required contrast).

hairline-strong.usage: Table rules, stronger separation, borders on canvas-2.

border-control.usage: Input, checkbox, radio and select borders. 3.5:1 on canvas — meets the 3:1 non-text minimum.

success.usage: In-stock, quote sent, success text and icons. 5.8:1 on canvas; white on it 6.3:1.

warning.usage: Lead-time and minimum-order warnings. 5.0:1 on canvas.

danger.usage: Validation errors, destructive actions. 6.0:1 on canvas; white on it 6.5:1.

focus.usage: Focus ring (2px, 2px offset) on light surfaces. On surface-ink use canvas-on-ink.

heading.usage: Headings, display numbers, nav wordmark, button labels (suggested).

body.source: Google Fonts via next/font/google (OFL). Weights 400, 500, 600. Enable `tnum` for tables.

mono.usage: SKUs, dimensions in spec tables, order numbers.

display-xl.usage: Homepage hero headline only. One per page.

h1.usage: Page title, product name on PDP.

h3.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, spec group headings.

body.usage: Default body, form fields (16px avoids iOS zoom).

body-sm.usage: Table cells, secondary copy, nav links.

caption.usage: Eyebrows, spec keys, badges. Always ink-muted or darker.

numeric.usage: Prices, quantities, MOQ, lead times — tabular figures so columns align.

display.usage: Display and h1 blocks (clamp sizes already carry their own).

measure.usage: Max line length for running text.

section.usage: Vertical rhythm between major page sections.

stack.usage: Default gap between stacked content blocks.

card-pad.usage: Card and panel inner padding (16px on mobile).

control-h.usage: Minimum height for buttons, inputs, selects — also the touch target.

container.usage: Max content width. Full-bleed imagery may exceed it.

sm.usage: Badges, chips, inputs — the industrial default.

lg.usage: Large panels, image stages inside cards.

full.usage: Avatars, swatch dots, pill toggles only. Not for primary buttons.

none.usage: Default. Separation comes from hairlines and background steps, not shadows.

overlay.usage: Dialogs, sheets, dropdown menus, sticky add-to-quote bar only.

motion.rule: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. No scroll-triggered entrance animations on content. Image zoom-on-hover ≤ 1.03.

hero-ratio.usage: Art-directed crops; keep the subject centred.

stage.usage: Studio background for cut-out product shots; consistent across a grid.

imagery.rule: Photography first: real bags, real kitchens, real hands. No stock 'business people shaking hands', no 3D blobs, no AI-generated people.
